name: Hearth and bellows
summary: A side-blown smith's hearth with a pair of leather hand bellows.

performance.heat: welding heat for wrought iron at the tuyere, over a fist-sized zone
performance.crucible_melt: a few lb of brass, bronze or lead at a time

flaws: Cannot melt iron in any quantity
Bellows need a second pair of hands (or a boy) whenever the smith is working
